dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: You sent me a message, sir.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Not an email.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Regardless.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: You should've checked!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: It is unprofessional to contact me through messages, Mr. Carter.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: You almost fired me for that.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Well, in this case.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: It was an emergency.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I had the same reason as last time.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: An emergency.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: But you still didn't consider it.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Remember?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Your message was also sent very late.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: It's inconsiderate to give me an immediate task on such short notice.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: I'm your boss.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: And you dare lecture me on this like I'm stupid?

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: I'm in charge for a fucking reason.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: For all you know, I'm the smartest person in this room.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: I don't have time for this.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: All women do is talk bullshit.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Your mouths never run out of spit when it comes to stupid crap.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: In conclusion…

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: There is no way you haven't checked your phone all day!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I was busy.

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: With what?

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Eating?

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Slouching?

dialogue.speaker: Carter
dialogue.text: Sleeping around?
